parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: This is the handle of a bucket, typically made of steel for strength and durability. It is a curved rod attached to the upper rim of the bucket.
parts.Functional_description: The handle allows the user to lift and carry the bucket easily, distributing the weight evenly when filled with liquid or solid materials.
parts.Movement_description: The handle can rotate or pivot around its attachment points on the bucket body, allowing it to move up and down for carrying or resting positions.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the bucket, made of galvanized steel to resist corrosion and provide structural integrity. It has a cylindrical shape with a slightly tapered bottom.
parts.Functional_description: The base body holds and contains liquids or solids, providing the main storage volume of the bucket.
parts.Movement_description: The base body is a fixed, rigid component that does not move independently; it supports the handle and maintains the bucket’s shape.
